description: USDA weekly downbound grain barge rates for the river corridor between two Mississippi, Illinois, or Ohio River places, with next week's outlook where it has passed a backtest. Says when the places aren't on a priced corridor. Does not count toward the allowance.

destination.description: Destination river city and state, e.g. 'New Orleans, LA'.

origin.description: Origin river city and state, e.g. 'St. Louis, MO'.

name: get_barge_outlook
title: Get the grain barge rate outlook for a river lane
